comment: An amazing professor that I would definitely recommend. She prepares you really well, and although tests are somewhat difficult, she gives final forgiveness, which really helps grades (as long as you study hard). It's organic chemistry, so you should expect to study; however, it is super easy to meet with her! Personable, caring, and energetic.

Dr. Hamm truly wants to help students understand. She is a particular grader but she does try to give partial credit where possible. She has a lot of office hours and provides a lot of resources to help practice and review the material. She tries to cram as much into each lecture as possible, which could get overwhelming and frustrating at times.

I would let Dr. Hamm lecture at me about literally anything. Our last lecture was about pee and it was still fascinating. She has a gift for teaching crazy amounts of challenging material and actually making it digestible and fun. I don't even really like chemistry but I loved this class because of Dr. Hamm.

Dr. Hamm is hands down the best professor and teacher of complicated material. She teaches in such a way that makes everything make sense. She does not try to trick you and prepares you extremely well for assessments. Practice problems and assessments mimic what is on the real assessments, unlike other professors. She is brilliant.
Biochem with Dr. Hamm was excellent! She is a great professor and an awesome person. Super funny too. Her method for teaching biochem sticks with you. Helped me out tremendously on the MCAT!!!!

Dr. Hamm was great and really gives you a thorough understanding of biochemistry. While she's a great teacher, the course is by no means an easy A. Because you cover a lot of dense material in lecture you need to review daily. Dr. Hamm's tests and quizzes are not meant to be tricky but instead try to see if you are able to apply the material.

Dr. Hamm does a lot to make sure you have everything you need to succeed. A peer tutor session every week. A Friday class which acts as a help session. Accessible in office hours. Group quizzes. Recorded lectures. Shares her own notes. Overall she's a hilarious, enthusiastic, bright woman and a great teacher who really wants everyone to do well.
One of the best Biochemistry professors. Her exams are really fair

Dr. Hamm is one of the best professors I have ever had. She really cares about her students and goes out of her way to make herself available to meet with her students outside of class. She gives out practice quizzes and exams prior to tests and quizzes which are extremely helpful. Also, she is a great lecturer and makes class really entertaining!!

Dr. Hamm was wonderful for biochemistry! She provides ample material for the tests and tries to support her students in every way she can. She always wanted specific answers to free response questions but never took off much at all and was very fair with grading in the end. If you can take her for biochem, you absolutely should!

I took Dr. Hamm for orgo 2 and biochem and I enjoyed having her for both. She gives 3 tests and a final, as well as occasional take home quizzes that you can do with small groups. While there isn't really consistent homework that's due, it's critical that you rewrite your notes/review frequently so that you are well-prepared for the tests.

Dr. Hamm is an incredibly smart woman. With that being said, she is easily frazzled and often has mini-panic attacks during class, which can be quite distracting. She is very approachable, but sometimes a bit condescending during office hours. Overall, I would take her again because I did learn a lot of biochemistry.

Dr. Hamm is super sweet and really cares about her students and wants you to do well. She gives a lot of practice problems and makes it clear what you should expect on the test. Lectures are important to not fall behind. The only thing is that she doesn't give homework so the only practice you get is from the posted test practice problems.

Dr. Hamms projects and papers allowed students to do research in areas they were interested in. The lectures were on the denser side, but a more general understanding of topics was sufficient to succeed on assessments.

Dr. Hamm is an amazing and caring professor. Her practice problems are extremely helpful for exam preparation. You need to be ready to put in time reviewing for exams, but there is no homework other than 3 take-home quizzes that you can do with other people. Do the practice problems, and you will be all set.

Dr. Hamm is hilarious and enthusiastic in class. She makes the tough biochem materials very accessible. This course requires countinuous effort but its worth since you can definitely learn a lot from her. She really cared about students and tried hard to improve teaching quality.
best prof at ur

A great teacher! Really helpful. She is really clear and always available for extra time. Tests are hard and the material is hard, but she really helps students to do well. If you put in the effort, you will do well.
Great professor, really wants to help her students learn. Tries to make the subject easier to understand. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!
SUCH A GOOD TEACHER!
I am taking her now and have already taken two tests. Tests are hard. I have to go to her before every test and ask questions and she is always helpful. I think making a B from her is possible.

she is straight forward and although the tests are difficult, she gives several pages of practice problems to help (which they do, assuming you actually do them). She also has a cool rule about tests, that if you do poorly on one, the final grade will count for that test, which is a godsend. And you can tell she cares about clarity.

Nice enough at first but plays favorites for sure. Very moody and sometimes rude. Definitely not hard- all you have to do is memorize her notes and problem sets- i've heard this is true for all the classes she teaches.

She was a good teacher, and fairly straightforward, but her tests were really hard... I think it would have helped if I had had her for 205 also and had more time to get used to her style.  Overall, I would recommend her over Clough though.
OHMYGOD DR. HAMM IS SOOOO COOL!  SERIOUSLY I LOVE HER SO MUCH!!  EVERYONE SHOULD TAKE HER SHE IS THE BESTEST!!!!!
She's not easy but then again she's teaching Ochem.  If you ask she'll help adn for an 8:15 she's ungodly energetic
very willing to help but not an easy prof.
Not as Wonderful as you all think
Fun, hilarious, and straightforward in her teaching approach.  Tough, but a winner all-around.
No Comments
Everyone tends to rave about Hamm, but I didn't think she was that great. Energetic personality, but she def. has her favorites and can be stand-offish.

This woman is great especially if you like morning classes.  Her tests aren't easy but she's always ready to help and she tells you what's on them beforehand.  She is straightforward, energetic, interesting and gives lots of examples.
